The FE model has no ribs, rib heads or costovertebral joints: the thoracic FSU is the bare motion segment (the task's rib heads / rib stumps are not modelled).
4-vertebra segments from T2-T7 (T2-T5, T3-T6, T4-T7), all ribs removed: each run, middle segment (T3-T4, T4-T5, T5-T6), mean of the three.
Specimen span run as the simulation states it (fixed caudal vertebra, load on the cranial one).
Load steps: the validation's (10 per FSU, 15 multi-level, per 7.5 Nm of peak, x 2 with a preload phase).
Load read off the run's linear ramp (FEBio load curve 0->1: load = peak x load fraction t); linear interpolation between solved steps.
Rotation = rotation vector of the upper body relative to the lower one projected on the upper disc's anatomical axis (run_tools.segment_angles, deg), signed positive in the loaded direction.
No preload: the simulation lists none and the run has none.
Side not stated: mean of the right and left runs (the model is not exactly symmetric).

Axial rotation side: run 'arr' = positive moment about the superior disc axis n (a anterior), the upper vertebra's front turning to the left = left axial rotation; 'arl' = right axial rotation (right-hand rule; derived from the code's axes, the run labels are not used as side names).
